location.site_context: City FAQ places the QTS campus along Highway 54 West between Veterans Parkway and Tyrone Road; DCA DRI #4603 places ATL2 East west of Veterans Parkway at 33.45435337191984, -84.51676089318552.

status_as_of_cutoff: partial live / site work-construction as of 2026-08-11. City and county sources confirm a QTS Data Centers campus in Fayetteville with active construction/resource issues; Microsoft says its Atlanta Fairwater AI datacenter began operation in October 2025, and AJC reports that facility is in Fayetteville within the QTS-developed campus with a May 2025 certificate of occupancy and September 25, 2025 construction completion certificate for the first building. The broader campus and ATL2 East expansion remain in development/local process.
evidence_grade: official/local-government for location, QTS campus identity, ATL2 East DRI, zoning, water, and air-permit applications; Microsoft/company and AJC for partial-live tenant/building status; MW capacity remains unverified by primary sources

history.reason: First independent refresh found local-government evidence for the QTS campus and ATL2 East, plus Microsoft/AJC evidence that the Atlanta/Fayetteville Fairwater building began operations in October 2025 while broader campus construction continues.
DCA DRI #4603 leaves peak connected electrical load as TBD; industry reports claim about 250 MW for Project Excalibur, but reviewed primary sources did not verify MW capacity.

owner: QTS Data Centers; project entities include QTS Fayetteville I, LLC at 1435 Hwy 54 West and QTS Eastwood, LLC for ATL2 East

milestones.government_body: Georgia Environmental Protection Division Air Protection Branch
milestones.result_status: Application No. 29366 received for QTS Fayetteville I, LLC at 1435 Hwy 54 West for a data center with emergency diesel-fired backup generators and a fire pump.
milestones.evidence_note: State environmental permit application evidence; not a capacity, occupancy, or energization record.

milestones.result_status: County action agenda records approval of an agreement with QTS Fayetteville I LLC for Contract #2567-B and award of Bid #2567-B for a traffic signal, supporting equipment, and guardrail at the QTS Data Center driveway on Tyrone Road.
milestones.evidence_note: Public infrastructure action tied to the QTS campus driveway.

milestones.result_status: Ordinance 25-0-34 rezoned QTS Eastwood, LLC parcels 0705 013 and 0705 019 on Veterans Parkway from Planned Community District to Business Park, with no building permit to issue until a development agreement addresses ARC DRI recommendations.
milestones.evidence_note: Local land-use approval for the ATL2 East/QTS Eastwood parcels; building permit conditioned on a development agreement.

milestones.result_status: DRI #4603 initial form submitted for ATL2 East by QTS Eastwood, LLC: 2,000,000 square-foot technological facility/data center on approximately 313 acres west of Veterans Parkway, with overall project completion listed as 2029.
milestones.evidence_note: Official state DRI filing for a QTS Eastwood expansion/adjacent campus.

milestones.government_body: Georgia Environmental Protection Division Air Protection Branch
milestones.result_status: Application No. 30027 received for QTS Fayetteville I, LLC at 1435 Hwy 54 West for installation of additional emergency generators.
milestones.evidence_note: State environmental permit application evidence for additional backup generation.

milestones.result_status: DRI #4603 Part 2 reports $3 billion estimated value at build-out, $29 million estimated annual local tax revenues, approximately 100 FTEs, Fayette County Water System demand of 0.20 MGD, City wastewater flow of 0.18 MGD, Georgia Power as energy provider, peak MW listed as TBD, and an on-site substation/new on-site transmission lines.
milestones.evidence_note: Official state DRI filing; explicitly does not verify peak MW.

milestones.government_body: Georgia Department of Community Affairs / Atlanta Regional Commission
milestones.result_status: DCA application summary lists ATL2 East DRI #4603 status as Completed, with projected process completion date 2026-04-24 and RDC finding/request for comments on 2026-04-21.
milestones.evidence_note: Completed regional-review process status, not construction completion.

milestones.result_status: County facts page says QTS and Fayette County Water resolved smart-meter billing/tracking issues, all meters are now connected, QTS was billed and paid at the construction rate for past water use, and QTS monthly usage over the past year was less than 1% of county water production and permitted capacity.
milestones.evidence_note: Official water-system/construction context; not a building occupancy or capacity record.

milestones.result_status: City FAQ states there is one data center campus in Fayetteville, QTS Data Centers, along Highway 54 West between Veterans Parkway and Tyrone Road; it says new data centers are prohibited in every city zoning district as of March 5, 2026 and the QTS facility includes 13 buildings totaling approximately 6.2 million square feet.
milestones.evidence_note: Official city source for campus identity, location, physical scale, and zoning-policy context.

milestones.result_status: Microsoft published that its Atlanta Fairwater AI datacenter began operation in October 2025; AJC reports Microsoft located the facility in Fayetteville within the QTS-developed campus and that Fayetteville issued a certificate of occupancy for the first QTS campus building in May 2025 plus a construction completion certificate on September 25, 2025.
milestones.evidence_note: Mixed company/local-media evidence for partial-live status; official city permit ledger or certificate images were not independently retrieved.
